questions.q: Which way was the wind blowing when Jip finally smelled the snuff?
choices: From the North
From the far East
From the South
From the West
questions.evidence: The wind's from the West and it smells of nothing but snuff

questions.q: How did the little boy feel when even the East wind brought no smell of snuff?
choices: Cheerful, because he was sure Jip would find him
Angry with Jip for not trying hard enough
Terribly disappointed, and he began to cry again
Sleepy, so he went back down to his silk bed
questions.evidence: The little boy was terribly disappointed and began to cry again

questions.q: How did Jip guide the Doctor to steer the ship?
choices: Jip barked once for left and twice for right from the top of the mast
The Doctor turned the ship whichever way Jip pointed his nose
Jip ran along the deck to the side the ship should turn
Jip told Dab-Dab, who flew back and told the Doctor
questions.evidence: whichever way I point it, you turn the ship the same way

questions.q: How did Jip know the boy's uncle was starving?
choices: The wind smelled only of snuff, with no food at all
He could hear the man calling out that he was hungry
The eagles told him the man had nothing to eat
The man's handkerchief smelled thin and weak
questions.evidence: there is no other smell in the West wind but snuff

questions.q: What did the swallows do after Jip said the man was starving?
choices: They flew ahead to look for the starving man
They carried food to the man in their beaks
They sang to keep the little boy from crying
They pulled the ship very fast, as before

questions.q: Who first saw the great rock far ahead?
choices: Jip, the dog
Dab-Dab, the duck
Too-Too, the owl
The little boy
questions.evidence: the owl, Too-Too, who was perched on the tip of the mast

questions.q: The rock was "as smooth and as bare as the back of a tortoise." What does "bare" mean here?
choices: Very hot from the sun shining on it
With nothing growing or lying on it
Very steep and hard to climb up
Covered with soft and slippery moss
questions.evidence: No trees grew on it, no grass--nothing

questions.q: What did Jip do after he and the Doctor got out onto the rock?
choices: He ran all over it with his nose to the ground
He lay down on the rock and waited for the uncle to come out
He barked loudly till his voice was hoarse
He dug a hole in the rock with his paws
questions.evidence: Jip at once put his nose down close to the ground and began to run all over the place

questions.q: Where did they finally find the boy's uncle?
choices: Sitting on top of the rock, waving a red handkerchief
Floating on a raft in the water beside the rock
Hiding behind a pile of sea-weed by the little waves
Asleep in a tiny room of rock at the end of a tunnel
questions.evidence: lay a man with very red hair--fast asleep!

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The swallows race the pirates' ship all the way across the open sea
Too-Too finds the uncle by listening at a key-hole
Jip's nose leads them to the lost uncle on a bare rock
The boy and his uncle sail home in The Saucy Sally
questions.evidence: It takes a dog to find a man
